evidence: Modifies P2P message processing in src/net_processing.cpp for INV message parsing and connection disconnect handling.
rationale: Enforces BIP 144 compliance by ignoring MSG_WITNESS_TX in INV messages and ensures block-relay-only connections disconnect on any transaction announcement regardless of inv type. As noted in the description, 'MSG_WITNESS_TX is only for use in getdata' and protocol violation checks were previously bypassed when an unexpected inv type was received on fRelay=false connections.
